name: AdvancedAntiVPN
relationship: Independent third party (HexedHero). Paid plugin (SpigotMC premium); bought at the listed price, not provided by the author.
license: Commercial, licensed to the buyer (not redistributed by this benchmark)
pins_note: One JAR for every platform. Folia is not advertised (plugin.yml has no folia-supported), so the Folia result records whether it loads. No previous release is pinned: only the current version was bought.

shipped.note: As downloaded: every service is disabled (Flagged Threshold 2), so it blocks nobody and warns that no service is enabled.

enforce.note: The services its own config.yml offers without a key (IP-API unlimited, ProxyCheck and VPNAPI 100 a day each) switched on; Flagged Threshold stays at its default 2, so two of three must agree. Nothing else changed.

proxycheck_key.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck key through its documented Services.ProxyCheck.Key field (same key for every product).

free_keys.note: enforce + the free ProxyCheck and VPNAPI keys through their documented key fields.

redis_note: No Redis option (SQLite or MySQL). Redis test not applicable.
telemetry: bStats - blocked like every product's telemetry
SpigotMC premium licence check (api.spigotmc.org, Paper only) and update check: forwarded as on a real server; the buyer id in it is masked
list_sources_note: Downloads no lists (the optional GeoLite2 country database needs a MaxMind key and stays off).
